blockers.finding: Both os.pipe allocations, Capture construction and cap.start() precede the try/finally. Second pipe allocation or construction/start failure bypasses all FD cleanup. If thread never starts, no worker owns cleanup of reads.
blockers.requiredRevision: Fresh version with transactional per-case setup and explicit pre-start parent ownership. Clean parent-owned read/write FDs on partial setup failure; transfer read ownership once worker start/claim is established. If start state is uncertain, do not cross-close active reader FDs; retain uncertainty/no hashes/no completion. Test allocation and thread-start exceptions with injected APIs before real fixture GO.
